map.多事件倒计时、纪念日节日倒计时、高考考研倒计时、番茄钟计时器: Multi-event countdowns, anniversary and holiday countdowns, exam countdowns and a Pomodoro timer
map.把时/分/秒输入统一折算为总秒数后每秒递减，再反算回时:分:秒显示；归零时触发提: The hour/minute/second input is converted to a total number of seconds and decremented each second, then converted back to h:m:s for display; an alert fires at zero. Timing uses setInterval(1000), and the browser may throttle it when the page goes to the background, so for long countdowns verify against the end moment.
map.：自定义时分秒倒计时，带进度环显示，支持暂停继续: : a custom hour/minute/second countdown with a progress ring and pause/resume
map.：添加重要日期（生日、考试、纪念日），实时显示剩余天数: : add important dates (birthdays, exams, anniversaries) to show the days remaining live
map.：自动计算距离今年/明年各大节日的剩余时间: : automatically computes the time to each major holiday this year or next
map.：25分钟专注+5分钟休息，提高工作效率: : 25 minutes of focus plus a 5-minute break to boost productivity
map.：自定义事件自动保存，刷新不丢失: : custom events are saved automatically and survive a refresh
map.HIIT 训练设 40 秒练 / 20 秒休循环，自动切换无需手动掐表。: For HIIT training, set a 40-second work / 20-second rest loop that switches automatically with no manual stopwatch.
map.训练 40s 练/20s 休循环，自动切换。: Training 40s work / 20s rest loop, switching automatically.
map.可设组数，完毕提示。: You can set the number of rounds; it alerts when done.
map.可以。设定练习与休息时长及循环次数后自动往复；组数较多时建议保持页面在前台以免定: Yes. Set the work and rest durations and the number of rounds and it repeats automatically; with many rounds, keep the page in the foreground so the timer is not throttled.
map.多功能倒计时器。日常生活工具，贴近生活，实用便捷。: Multi-Function Countdown Timer. A daily-life tool that is practical and convenient.
map.倒计时口径：总秒数 = 小时 × 3600 + 分钟 × 60 + 秒，启动后每: Countdown rule: total seconds = hours × 3600 + minutes × 60 + seconds; after starting, the remaining seconds decrease by 1 every second and the timer stops with an alert at zero. Validation: a total ≤0 shows a warning and refuses to start, and repeated start clicks are ignored while running. Display: the remaining time is decomposed into h:m:s by integer division by 3600 and 60; no numeric grading.
